recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑顯著增厚、互相融合連接，骨質佔據大部分切片，並可見不規則的膠合線（cement lines）；殘存骨髓腔狹窄，只剩纖維血管性基質而幾乎沒有造血細胞，符合骨硬化（osteosclerosis），可解釋慢性腎病病人的全血球減少。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying most of the core
Irregular cement lines and woven-to-lamellar remodeling pattern
Narrow residual marrow spaces filled with fibrovascular stroma
Near absence of hematopoietic cells and fat
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, irregular, and anastomosing bony trabeculae containing irregular cement lines that occupy the majority of the specimen. The residual intertrabecular spaces are narrow and filled with loose fibrovascular stroma, with near-complete absence of hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with osteosclerosis with marrow fibrosis and hematopoietic depletion, which in a patient with chronic kidney disease is attributable to renal osteodystrophy and explains the pancytopenia.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with dilated sinusoids and intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis, and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation.
Metastatic carcinoma shows keratin-positive tumor nests within the fibrotic intertrabecular spaces.
Paget disease shows a mosaic cement-line pattern with bizarre osteoclasts and is usually focal rather than diffuse with a CKD context.
Osteopetrosis has persistent calcified cartilage cores within trabeculae in a young patient with a genetic osteoclast defect.
